description: Swipes from one point to another (input swipe). With the same start and end point and a duration ≥ 500 ms it is a long press.

serial.description: adb serial (e.g. emulator-5556). Optional when only one device is connected.

x1.description: Start x, normalized 0–1 over the screenshot

x2.description: End x, normalized 0–1 over the screenshot

y1.description: Start y, normalized 0–1 over the screenshot

y2.description: End y, normalized 0–1 over the screenshot

name: swipe
title: Swipe
